purpose: Reject behavior as unsuitable by invoking what someone is not.
keywords: You are not a child; tidy up after yourself.
We are not machines; we need rest too.
It is not our first meeting; don’t be so nervous.
mistake: The noun describes an inappropriate comparison, not the actual identity.
